'''Barcaria''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWTORE" /> located in the [[Barcaria system/Legends|Barcaria system]], a part of the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the commodity known as [[Barcarian claw salt]].<ref name="Valentine" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

The [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jace Malcom]] had a [[Jace Malcom's family ranch|ranch]] on Barcaria where he spent his youth. Upon coming of age at some point by [[3681 BBY]], Malcom, wishing to see the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], enlisted with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and was posted off-world.<ref name="SWTORE" /> At one point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Barcaria on a mission for members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barcaria was introduced as a map label in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-16.<ref name="TEA" /> It was subsequently described as a planet by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWTORE" />
